title: LiveCount 3D: Streamlining 2D and 3D Construction Takeoff
summary: LiveCount 3D, available in Benelux, is the new 3D takeoff capability from Trimble. It extracts quantities automatically from models, so estimators can prepare accurate bids faster, update quantities when designs change, and collaborate with architects and engineers.
